thread:
aline_csm: Vireo Health wants a short-lived regional pin + header allowlist for an EU customer demo next weekend. They said if latency spikes during the demo well lose the renewal. Need ops + SRE to stand up a safe burst config.

pranav_sre: Got it. What are the exact header(s)/CIDR(s), target burst, and demo window? Also confirm Hosted vs Dedicated.

aline_csm: Header to allow: X-Client-ID: vireo-demo (their demo proxy injects this).
CIDR: 34.210.0.0/16 (their CDN edge)
Current steady RPS: ~300; request burst to 1.2k (soft cap) for the window.
Window: 2026-04-10T06:00Z -> 2026-04-13T06:00Z
Tenant: hosted (org:vireo-prod)
Note: they asked for EU-only routing (eu-west1 preferred) and a short TTL so this doesnt become permanent.

tess_sales: Adding renewal risk = MEDIUM until demo completes. If we can guarantee the demo experience we push renewal to on-track. Also asked product marketing for a small case-study if demo goes well.

pranav_sre: Plan suggestion:
- Create header-allow entry (name: vireo-demo-339001)
- Apply per-org soft-ceiling: 1200 rps, hard-throttle at 1500
- Route traffic prefer eu-west1, fallback eu-central1
- KV cache warmup for top-30 prefixes 1h before window
- TTL 72h + auto-revoke
Rollback: remove header allow + revert routing -> instant
Internal apply commands for infra team:
```
redwood-admin header-allow add --name vireo-demo-339001 \
  --header "X-Client-ID:vireo-demo" \
  --cidr 34.210.0.0/16 \
  --org vireo-prod \
  --ttl 72h \
  --auto-revoke

redwood-admin rate set --org vireo-prod \
  --soft-ceiling 1200 --hard-throttle 1500 \
  --region-preference eu-west1 --fallback eu-central1
```

ryan_ops: I'll schedule the KV warmup job 1 hour before start and attach a small runbook to the allowlist page. Will also pin autoscale hint to eu fleet. Waiting for infra-bot confirmation.

infra-bot: header-allow created (id: hla-12011). rate policy applied (rp-77234). start=2026-04-10T06:00Z end=2026-04-13T06:00Z. Links: https://internal.redwood/allowlists/hla-12011 , https://internal.redwood/policies/rp-77234

aline_csm: Thanks. Please add a dashboard watch and alert me and @tess_sales at 70% of the soft ceiling. Also annotate the renewal tracker row with the allowlist id and policy id.

pranav_sre: Watch added: dashboard/vireo-prod/latency+buckets -> alert @aline_csm @tess_sales at 70% soft. Added short rollback steps to both linked pages. FYI estimated short-term cost delta ~+10% for the window due to regional pinning and cache priming.

tess_sales: Confirmed Ill update the renewal note and finance will be notified if we exceed the soft ceiling during the demo.

aline_csm: Closing loop for now. Ill post a quick usage snapshot at +1h once the demo starts and another after the demo ends. :rocket:
